title: Mobile Pick Preview
brief: Drive near an object, move the arm, and close the gripper in simulation.
starterPython:
robot.home()
robot.open_gripper()
robot.drive_forward(30, seconds=1.0)
robot.move_joint("shoulder_lift", -25, speed=35)
robot.move_joint("elbow_flex", 45, speed=35)
robot.close_gripper()
robot.stop()
successCriteria: moves at least one arm joint
